selection_rationale: An all-torpedo fleet carrying 64 rounds, fired in coordinated salvos of up to 12 per 30s, to overwhelm enemy point defence. The torpedo cruiser's 241cm armoured nose and 4 PD turrets anchor the group. The fast hulls can pull away, so enemy rounds hit the tail with less energy, and they can keep away from slow gun capitals once their magazines are empty.
formation_rationale: The torpedo cruiser sits 60 km back so it stays out of gun range longer and can launch from standoff distance. The two corvettes form a forward screen offset left/right and up/down. They take the first exchange, and their lateral and vertical spread makes enemy spinal targeting harder. All three ships are within about 100 km of each other, so their PD coverage overlaps against incoming torpedoes.
